title: Resource trust policy, v1
$comment: ADR-062 §6 — the creator's dial. One policy per resource (repo/site/project/file/platform), set by its owner, governing how much agent-EI matters ON THIS RESOURCE and what the owner may override. Ownership is authoritative and lives with the resource (account-server product_accounts for Windy resources; the platform's own roster otherwise); this schema is the shape platforms serialize + validate. An ABSENT or minimal policy = sovereign-permissive (the defaults below): the owner's good-standing agent works hands-free, a dropped agent works with one owner co-sign, only money/destructive ask once, and even a revoked agent stays owner-operable. 'Root means root' (ADR-062 §1): the verified owner is never refused on their own resource — the policy tunes friction and autonomy, it cannot lock a verified owner out of their own stuff (only the owner may choose to lock themselves via override_forbidden_actions).

resource.$comment: Opaque resource id, meaningful to the owning platform.

owner.$comment: The resource owner — an Eternitas EH operator passport (or a platform identity that resolves to one). Verified via Eternitas identity, NEVER agent-asserted.

admins.$comment: Delegated-admin EH passports who may also co-sign for this resource (the engineer-on-a-company-repo case). Empty by default.

min_ei_autonomous.$comment: EI below which the agent needs owner/admin co-sign to act on this resource UNSUPERVISED. Default 600 (Standard): a good-standing agent acts hands-free on its owner's resource; a dropped agent still works, with one owner co-sign. Raise for stricter resources; the owner co-sign path stays available regardless (unless override:none).

override.$comment: Who may co-sign an override on this resource. 'none' = a strict resource where the owner has chosen NO override (e.g. locked prod) — the owner locking themselves, which sovereignty permits.

session_grants.$comment: Allow 'approve everything on this resource while I'm working' (session-scoped, expires). Disallowed → per-action co-sign only.

confirmations.$comment: The always-confirm floor for money/destructive on THIS resource. 'default' = ask once (a confused/hijacked agent can't do the irreversible in the owner's name; one human yes answers it). 'off' = the owner has turned confirmations off for their own resource ('just do it'). ADR-062 §1: confirmation is defeatable, never a refusal.

override_forbidden_actions.$comment: Actions that are NEVER overridable on this resource — the owner choosing to lock even themselves (e.g. deploy_prod). Empty by default.

revoked_agent.$comment: Whether a REVOKED agent may still be owner-operated on this resource. 'owner-root' (default) = yes, fully, via verified co-sign, with a one-time compromise informed-consent screen (ADR-062 §5). 'none' = the owner has chosen that a revoked agent gets nothing here.
